race.description: Patriot Bloodstock Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: STATE SECRET (3) has transferred from Tulloch Lodge to Matthew Dale and is back after a four-month spell. Beaten less than a length when fresh from a spell last prep over 1200m at Wyong. Finds an easier first-up assignment this time around and is nicely placed to get immediate results for the new stable. PLAYFUL AS (10) is back from a 27-week break and has switched from the Hayes stable to Maddison Collins. Placed twice in four runs during the maiden campaign. Should return in good order. MASKED VISION (1) returns for a second prep following a 23-week spell. Has started at $4.20 or less in all five runs. Has ability and this looks well within reach. O'HATASKY (12) just missed at Canberra last start and from a good gate is a major player. SHEZRUSHIN (13) will probably appreciate coming back in distance. Lightly raced and worth plenty of thought.
